tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The contractor shall guarantee all the materials supplied by him including erection, electrification work for trouble free top class performance and against manufacturing defects for a period of one year from the date of satisfactory completion, commissioning and handing over to user department. The contractor shall make his own arrangement for rectifying defects/replacement of defective materials immediately on receipt of intimation from executing authority and power supply shall be restored. Failure of which, action will be taken to get the work rectification through other agency at the risk and cost of the contractor.
All necessary drawings, paper works, etc. and any other formalities required to be observed shall be the responsibility of contractor.
The quantities shown in the schedule are approximate. The actual quantities will be executed as per site condition only. Any balance materials shall be taken back by the contractor
The contractor shall not deviate/alter/execute excess quantities or additional items without prior approval.
It is the responsibility of the contractor to pursue and obtain all necessary approvals related to work from respective departments.
During the execution of any Minor Civil works or any other minor works which are to be executed, has to be done by the bidder from his end without any charges.
The tenderer shall pass on to the department all the warranties, benefits etc. From the original equipment manufacturers
Conditional Tenders will not be accepted.
All materials required for this work, shall be procured by the Tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities, at his own cost before use on the work

The project shall be completed well within the contract period, the Tenderer should maintain the works of his scope during the defect liability period, which is 1 Year after the successful completion of the work
The tender must furnish all technical qualification information in the prescribe formats as per Standard tender document
Safety to contractor work men/ General public is the responsibility of bidder
Tree Cut/ trimming of trees, in Co- Ordination with forest Dept. etc., is the responsibility of bidder
Co-Ordinating line clear works with Bescom is the responsibility of bidder in consultation with local Bescom officers.
Getting electrical inspectorate approval is responsibility of contractor
The Work should be carried out as per the list of makes uploaded.

The Contractor shall obtain all necessary clearance from electrical inspectorate TA&QC as per Bescom for erection & commissioning of VC breakers/ Transformers/HT Cables/LT CABELS/Metering cubicles etc.
All materials required for this work, shall be procured by the Tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities, at his own cost before use on the work

After delivery at site, the materials will be inspected, if the materials do not conform to relevant ISS/ISI and technical specifications of KPTCL/BESCOM/MESCOM, then such materials will be rejected. The contractor shall remove the rejected materials at his own cost.

It is the responsibility of contractor to co-ordinate with executing authority for commissioning the Breaker, HT/LT lines and TCs satisfactory by observing all formalities up to handing over to the user department. After this only, final bill shall be prepared.

It is the responsibility of contractor to observe all necessary formalities of Becom for charging the lines and taking over the infrastructure like breaker lines TCs by Bescom authorities for cables satisfactorily duly acknowledging the inventory of materials used in the work
The Contractor must obtain the necessary approvals as per fire norms from the concerned fire authority.

It shall be the responsibility of the bidder to obtain necessary line clearance from BESCOM and special care has to be taken while working with live conductor. Department is not responsible for any untoward accidents.

Bidder must visit construction site before closure of tender to get the clear scope of the project and upload site vist acknowledgement letter in KPPP Portal if fails bidder will be disqaulified from the technical bid

The bidder must upload a duly notarized affidavit strictly as per the prescribed format only(uploaded in tender document). Any deviation or non-compliance shall lead to outright rejection of the bid without prior notice

The bidder shall be solely responsible for testing, erection, commissioning, including labour, transportation, and all incidental works, and no additional cost whatsoever shall be paid by the Procuring Entity.
